name: DeepFilterNet

install.macos: Download the pinned deep-filter release binary into a project directory (examples/deepfilternet-speech-denoise/run.sh does this inside output/, SHA-256 checked); no PATH install.

notes: 2026-11-27: Lead differed: latest release is v0.5.6 (2023-08-31); a darwin aarch64 binary exists in its assets (lead said unverified); release assets carry no published digest, so the fixture pins its own SHA-256.

2026-11-27: Model weights are covered by the README licence section (MIT or Apache-2.0 at your option, 'all code and model weights'); the deep-filter binary embeds the default DeepFilterNet model. Training-data terms not checked.
2026-11-27: Evidence partial: SNR improved 12.3 dB on say speech plus white noise, but the output is 1440 samples shorter than the input even with -D (KNOWN FAIL, kept).

evidence.result: 4.7 s say speech (48 kHz mono) plus seeded white noise at 5.0 dB SNR through deep-filter -D: SNR vs clean 17.3 dB, +12.3 dB (floor +8.0, passed). 48 kHz mono 16-bit output; two runs byte-identical. KNOWN FAIL: output 223723 samples vs 225163 in (1440 short, 30 ms) despite -D.
evidence.scope: Partial: one synthetic-noise SNR gain on say speech, macOS arm64, pinned binary, gain-aligned SNR on the shared prefix; output length check fails (KNOWN FAIL); real noise and recordings untested.

summary: Rust CLI (deep-filter) and Python package that suppress background noise in 48 kHz speech with a small neural model, using prebuilt release binaries. Cleans narration before loudness normalisation.
use_when: Clean noisy voice-over or screen-recording narration before normalising
Reduce steady broadband noise (hiss, fans) in speech
avoid_when: Fixed EQ, gate or compression chains: sox or pedalboard
Music or non-speech sound: it is trained for speech
license: MIT or Apache-2.0 at your option, code and model weights (upstream README, checked 2026-11-27); training-data, input and output rights not assessed

assessment.rationale: Free-software code and weights, official macOS arm64 binary with no Python needed, a clear gap beside sox and pedalboard. Latest release is old (2023) though the repository is still pushed to; pin the binary.
